output.answer_markdown: As of FY2022, Johnson & Johnson's gross margin was 67.3% [1], using gross profit and revenue as originally filed. Both figures were later restated, and this figure does not reflect the restated values; the restated amounts are not provided here. The material does not include a prior-year gross margin, so the change cannot be measured, and it does not break down the cost of products or revenue drivers behind any change. The filings do state a general aim: the company strives to maintain its profit margins through cost reduction programs, productivity improvements and periodic price increases [2], but this does not quantify or attribute a gross margin change.
